content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at UNESCO. Tell about your experience in international cooperation in education, science and culture, world heritage protection, and intercultural dialogue. Describe your vision for UNESCO's role in promoting peace and sustainable development. Length about 450 words.
